observations.excavator: Both previews show a deep empty bucket mouth, separate articulated arm links and rods, framed cab, tread loop and rollers. Native probes additionally confirm both track interiors remain open.
observations.mine_cart: The deep open tapered bed and thick rim read at both sizes; wheel flanges, braces, couplers and hand brake remain substantial.
observations.mine_elevator: Four-post headframe, exposed sheave, cage opening, winding drum, continuous cable route and stairs read at both sizes. Close twin strands merge locally in the half grid.
observations.ore_sorter: Open hopper, sloping perforated screen, short rising discharge belt and three separately framed ore bins read at both sizes; aperture pattern survives reduction.
